newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH NBP SELLS PLN 700 MLN BILLS, YIELDS RISE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH NBP SELLS PLN 700 MLN BILLS, YIELDS RISE.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland sold 200 million zlotys of 91-day NBP-bills after Polish banks bid for 287 million, the NBP said on Wednesday.
It also sold 500 million zlotys of 273-day NBP-bills after banks bid for 633 million.
The average yield for the shorter bill inched up to 21.99 percent from 21.96 percent on January 3.
The average yield of the 273-day paper jumped to 22.00 percent from 21.01 percent yesterday.
